name: Auto Author Assigner by Adaan
author: Adaan

sections.description:
User Name Assigner by Adaan is a powerful plugin that automatically assigns WordPress users as authors to posts and updates publish dates randomly.
🚀 Why Use This Plugin?
✅ Auto-assign authors to posts
✅ Randomly change post publish dates
✅ Improve workflow & automation for large content sites

sections.installation:
1. Download and unzip the user-name-assigner.zip file.
  2. Upload the folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  3. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  4. Go to User Name Assigner in the WordPress admin panel and start assigning authors.
sections.faq:
How does it assign authors?

The plugin selects users from the provided list and assigns them as post authors.

Can I add my own list of users?

Yes! You can add and manage the user list from the plugin settings page.
